title: Woman in 1940s Dress Outdoors, Vintage Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor snapshot photograph capturing a woman standing on a lawn in front of a wooden-sided building, taken during the early 1940s. She wears a classic WWII-era belted button-front dress with a flared A-line skirt and short sleeves, paired with dark pumps and styled hair typical of mid-20th century fashion. A bicycle rests against the building facade in the background.
